Messages.Author: James Puzzo
Messages.Body:
Can someone explain the differences between melee and hand damage with regards
to card effects and modifiers? I am thoroughly confused as to the difference
now that I've been trying to follow some of the discussions on the group.

-James

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:


Hand damage is the innate damage your vampire can do, without using any
strike cards (except those that increase hand damage) and without using
any weapons. As far as I can think of, there's no standard/official definition
of "melee damage", though it would presumably start with strikes made with
melee weapons, and possibly including hand damage as well.
